findings.description: The draft mis-attributed uncommitted patch-surface drift to the authoritative wrapper registry instead of the inner submodule's vestigial docs file.
findings.resolution: Updated plan, research brief, and requirements to state that `codex/docs/implementation/patch-surface.md` is authoritative and the dirty inner `docs/implementation/patch-surface.md` is out of scope.
findings.suggestedFix: Avoid staging the inner vestigial patch-surface drift unless the lead expands scope.

findings.description: The draft omitted the wrapper `external/repos/codex-patched` gitlink bump from the two-commit flow.
findings.resolution: Updated plan, stories, research brief, and decomposition sidecar to require the wrapper gitlink bump to the inner marker commit, or an explicit lead-approved deferral.
findings.suggestedFix: Commit inner markers first, then update wrapper registry plus wrapper gitlink in the codex wrapper commit.
